Node.js 26.9.0 builds `deps/v8/src/builtins/builtins-sharedarraybuffer.cc`, which includes `src/base/platform/yield-processor.h`. That header emits the ARMv7 `isb` mnemonic for every ARM target with `__ARM_ARCH >= 6`, but GNU `as` rejects `isb` when the actual target is ARM1176JZF-S / ARMv6. Keep the ARMv7 path for ARMv7+, use the pre-ARMv7 CP15 ISB form on GNU compilers, and let the MSVC ARMv6 fallback be a no-op because this repository does not build ARMv6 with MSVC.
